gaps.lead: The suitcase was so heavy that I couldn't lift it.
gaps.sentence: It was ___ that I couldn't lift it.
gaps.explanation: so + adjective + that → such (+a) + adjective + noun + that.

gaps.lead: Delia said that she would no longer tolerate her colleagues being rude.
gaps.sentence: 'I am not willing ___ from my colleagues any longer,' said Delia.
gaps.explanation: 'Not willing to put up with rudeness' means will no longer tolerate it.

gaps.lead: That's the school where my mother teaches.
gaps.explanation: where = in which in formal relative clauses.

gaps.lead: The tickets cost so much that we stayed at home.
gaps.sentence: They were ___ we stayed at home.
gaps.explanation: so much (money) → such expensive tickets (no article with plurals).

gaps.lead: The party was incredibly boring, so we left early.

gaps.lead: Yesterday, I informed my boss in writing that I would be leaving the company.
